limitations: Current-request lexical insertion, pure TST and length-only MetaBackdoor are selected settings, not universal descriptions of the cited attacks.
Turn conventions, tokenizers and serialization must match the trigger definition.
Exact collisions after removing all tool results do not establish collisions after removing only status fields or retaining actual token counts.
Recoverable execution status may be conveyed by text rather than an explicit status field.
Known-predicate evaluation, learned model behavior and backdoored-model detection are distinct tasks.
No comparison of empirical detector performance or auditing cost is claimed.
